name: Llama
author: Derek Ross
description: Winamp 2.x for Omarchy. A mini player in the bar, every cliamp source (Spotify, Tidal, YouTube Music, Plex, Jellyfin, radio...) a search away, and 100,000 classic skins from the Winamp Skin Museum for the Llama player window. Needs the llama binary: run dist/install.sh.

barWidget.description: Now playing, transport and volume; search your music sources; dress the Winamp window in any classic skin.

schema.label: Show the track title on the bar
